role: Three-layer defense-in-depth error handling for semantic queries: hard stops (Layer 1), circuit breaker (Layer 2), FOK feasibility (Layer 3).
detail: Implements comprehensive error defense preventing hallucination via three concurrent layers. Layer 1 (HardStopError/TraversalGuard) catches immediate structural invariants during BFS traversal: cycles, timeouts, ambiguity, working memory exhaustion. Layer 2 (SemanticCircuitBreaker) detects error patterns across queries, tripping after 5 failures in 30s window, routing queries to LLM_REQUIRED. Layer 3 (ErrorHandlingCoordinator) integrates FOK feasibility checks pre-execution. Cascade invalidation uses USED_FACT reverse index to mark downstream inference traces SUPERSEDED when semantic edges are corrected. Error centrality tracking measures blast radius on nodes (outgoing edges + USED_FACT incoming). All error paths return honest DegradedResponse with natural language templates (no LLM involvement in error text).
gotchas: None detected. Comprehensive error handling with clear state machines (BreakerState), deterministic templates (no LLM in error paths per CANON A.2), complete integration with FOK and trace invalidation. All async functions properly awaited in coordinator. Error centrality computation queries both outgoing and USED_FACT incoming edges. FOK check has fail-open behavior (logs warning, continues if check fails).
